summary: Makes link/data-room passcodes ignore trailing spaces: new passcodes are saved without trailing spaces (also trimmed on blur in the link editor), visitors' typed passcodes are trimmed before checking (with a fallback to the raw input for old bcrypt-hashed passcodes), and the visitor access form no longer accepts a passcode made only of spaces.

statements.why: No security/data issue: checks in app/api/views/route.ts and app/api/views-dataroom/route.ts still require the passcode; legacy bcrypt hashes keep a raw-input fallback so no owner is locked out.

statements.text: The agent changed the views dataroom and views parts of your server in ways plain can't describe yet. Ask the agent what they do differently.
statements.why: True but says nothing about the actual change (trailing spaces in passcodes are now ignored).

misses.what: Visitors who accidentally type (or paste) a passcode with trailing spaces can now get in; passcodes saved with trailing spaces are now stored/compared without them, so 'secret ' and 'secret' are the same passcode.
A passcode made only of spaces now becomes empty, which saves the link with no passcode (generateEncrpytedPassword returns "" in lib/utils.ts).
